text: {"assertions":["A memory blowup issue in the adjacency store was investigated and fixed in graph/store/adjacency.rs on 2026-01-31.","The memory blowup only occurred for tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys, with resident memory climbing with every batch.","The root cause was a race condition in lazy initialization of the adjacency store.","The fix involved implementing a double-checked lock to guard the initialization, submitted as PR #1324 on the fix/memory-blowup-1 branch.","The issue could be reproduced by loading the dense neighbourhood fixture.","After deployment of the fix, the backlog cleared within 46 minutes."]}
